faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About PDF Compression

browserTools.question: How is this different from browser-based tools?
browserTools.answer: SlimPDF uses server-side Ghostscript, the same engine used by professional print shops. Browser tools are limited to JavaScript compression which typically achieves 20-40% reduction. We achieve up to 90%.

security.question: Are my files secure?
security.answer: Yes. All transfers use 256-bit encryption. Files are automatically deleted after 1 hour (free) or 24 hours (Pro). We never store or analyze your file contents.

targetSize.question: Can I compress to a specific file size?
targetSize.answer: Yes! Pro users can set a target size like "under 10MB" for email. We'll iterate compression until we hit your target while maintaining readable quality.

watermarks.question: Do you add watermarks?
watermarks.answer: Never. Your PDF comes out clean on all plans. We believe watermarks ruin the user experience.

apiAccess.question: What's included in API access?
apiAccess.answer: Pro subscribers get full REST API access for compression, merging, and image-to-PDF. Simple endpoints, code examples in multiple languages, and 100 requests/hour.

quality.question: Does compression reduce PDF quality?
quality.answer: No. SlimPDF uses intelligent compression that removes unnecessary data while preserving text clarity and image quality. We achieve up to 90% size reduction without making PDFs look blurry or illegible.

specificSizes.question: Can I compress PDF to 5MB, 3MB, 1MB, or under 500KB?
specificSizes.answer: Yes! Our "Target Exact Size" feature lets you specify your desired file size (5MB, 3MB, 1MB, 500KB, etc.) and we'll compress your PDF until it reaches that target. This is especially useful for email attachments.

signup.question: Do I need to sign up to compress PDFs?
signup.answer: No sign-up required for our free tier. You can compress up to 2 PDFs per day without creating an account. For unlimited compressions, upgrade to Pro with just one click.

platforms.question: Can I compress PDFs on Mac, Windows, and Linux?
platforms.answer: Yes! SlimPDF is a web-based tool that works on any device with a browser—Mac, Windows, Linux, iPad, and more. No software installation needed.

largePdf.question: What's the best way to compress a large PDF?
largePdf.answer: Upload your PDF to SlimPDF and let our Ghostscript engine do the work. For very large files (100MB+), use our Pro tier for 100MB support and batch processing of multiple files at once.

email.question: Can I compress PDF files for email?
email.answer: Absolutely. Many email providers limit attachment sizes to 25MB. Our compression typically reduces files by 60-90%, making them ideal for email. Use our "Target Exact Size" feature to compress to under 10MB or 5MB.

batch.question: Can I batch compress multiple PDF files?
batch.answer: Yes. With Pro tier, you can upload up to 20 PDF files at once and compress them all together. Download the results as a single ZIP file.

fileSizes.question: What file sizes can I compress—5MB, 10MB, 50MB, 100MB?
fileSizes.answer: Free tier supports up to 20MB per file (2 per day). Pro tier handles up to 100MB files with unlimited daily compressions. Whether your PDF is 5MB, 10MB, 50MB, or 100MB, we can compress it.
